Title: Apex GT3 Endurance Sprint
Description: Experience the roar of GT3-spec machinery in a grueling 3-hour sprint. This event features a dedicated BMW M-Series paddock and a pit-lane walk for VIP ticket holders.

Title: Scalable Node.js & PostgreSQL Masterclass
Description: A deep dive into building resilient backends using Node.js and PostgreSQL. We will cover database normalization, API optimization, and real-time telemetry integration.

Title: Adobe Lightroom: Advanced Post-Processing
Description: Elevate your digital photography by mastering Adobe Lightroom. Learn advanced masking techniques, color grading for landscapes, and efficient catalog management to solve common post-processing glitches.

Title: Gray Zone: Tactical Operations Tournament
Description: Form your squad for a high-stakes tactical shooter tournament. This event focuses on team coordination, objective-based gameplay, and strategic maneuvering in competitive environments.

Title: Rooftop Jazz & Tapas Night
Description: Join us for an evening of live jazz as the sun sets over the city. Tickets include a curated selection of artisanal tapas and local wine pairings for a premium social experience.

Title: Green Horizons: IoT in Conservation
Description: Explore how IoT telemetry and satellite imagery are being used to monitor water quality and environmental health. This symposium highlights technical solutions for real-world ecological challenges at local dams.
